data: François Foucault, la quarantaine, est professeur agrégé de lettres au lycée Henri IV, à Paris. Une suite d’évènements le force à accepter une mutation d’un an dans un collège de banlieue classé REP +. Il redoute le pire. À juste titre. (Teacher in the most prestigious highschool in the country, François enjoys the life he’s always known, in the intellectual and bourgeois society of Paris. Trapped in a situation where he’s forced to accept a job in a school of a tough underprivileged suburb, he finds himself confronted to his own limits and to the upheaval of his values and certainties.)

François Foucault, la quarantaine, est professeur agrégé de lettres au lycée Henri IV, à Paris. Une suite d’évènements le force à accepter une mutation d’un an dans un collège de banlieue classé REP +. Il redoute le pire. À juste titre.

Teacher in the most prestigious highschool in the country, François enjoys the life he’s always known, in the intellectual and bourgeois society of Paris. Trapped in a situation where he’s forced to accept a job in a school of a tough underprivileged suburb, he finds himself confronted to his own limits and to the upheaval of his values and certainties.
